purpose: Use existing ai/runtime-exchange request/response pairs as the point-in-time structured source for baseline/challenger shadow benchmarking without adding extra scheduled runs.
eligible_case_source: PVA_AI_EXCHANGE_REQUEST_V1 paired with a valid PVA_AI_EXCHANGE_RESPONSE_V1 for the same run_id and request_sha256
candidate_link_rule: role_result.candidate_ids must list every bundled candidate the role actually evaluated and must not list candidates it did not evaluate
transport_self_reference_rule: an ai_exchange request/response self-reference may be retained for provenance but must be marked relevant=false for evidence-yield metrics
source_family_rule: derive source_family from the underlying public source or durable knowledge artifact, never from persuasive interpretation

decision_rule.KILL: a candidate-linked prebuild_killer or chief_falsifier role_result is FALSIFIED
decision_rule.CLOSED_NEGATIVE: reserved for an externally established canonical closed-negative state; scheduled workers themselves have no close-negative authority

counterfactual_challenger.input_cutoff: request object before its paired AI response exists
counterfactual_challenger.selection: formal Research OS scheduler may select only tasks present in the request work_items
counterfactual_challenger.evidence_accounting: challenger may count only role_result telemetry from roles selected using pre-response request state
counterfactual_challenger.missing_selected_role_result: fail closed; do not impute evidence or zero metrics
counterfactual_challenger.extra_baseline_role_result: may count for BASELINE but not CHALLENGER if the formal pre-response scheduler did not select it
